Changes: selected algorithms and design patterns rewritten for MAD's pure-time
SVG renderer, namespaced registry, bounded inputs and asset/cache contracts.
No ElevenLabs client, external image generator, autoplay policy, parallel
render default or universal beat/half-frame offset is imported. Upstream
validation claims are not inherited. Original demo footage is not bundled.
